Approve sending the async questionnaire to Samir after a final 24-hour window for a live slot. If Samir submits a written response, please map answers to our scoring template and put a bolded summary at the top of your notes (no more than 3 bullets).

If Samir remains silent after the async attempt, go with option (b) — ask Manu for alternate ref and prioritize a manager-level reference if possible.

Scoring guidance for the debrief (short):
- Impact: evidence of real deliverables and outcomes (0–4)
- Execution: ownership, reliability, tradeoff decisions (0–4)
- Collaboration: communication and partnering (0–4)

Marissa — please send the async questionnaire and keep me in the loop. I trust you to synthesize and flag if anything is surprising.
